services.name: Fly fishing
services.desc: Comfort and stability. Our 27 foot Pursuit Offshore sister ships the "Red Sky" and the "Golden Horizon" are build to yacht grade standards insuring a smooth and stable ride on the open ocean and the protected inlets. Private flush toilet, comfortable seating for up to five. Quiet, clean twin four stroke outboards power the boats. Your safety is important to us Our vessels are meet and exceed Transport Canada standards as small commercial vessels. The boats are quipped with high end electronics including radar. Auto inflate collar life jackets and rain pants are available. Premium fishing equipment. Enjoy fishing with high quality rods and reels. Islander and Avet reels, Shimano and Sage
